g.text: power-usbc: USB-C 5 V (5.1k on CC1/CC2) -> 1.1 A PTC -> DC-DC boost + inverter at 1.38 MHz -> +12.24 V / -12.13 V -> ferrite + 10 uF -> XH 1 -12V 2 GND 3 +12V

g.desc: power-usbc: USB-C 5 V (5.1k on CC1/CC2) -> 1.1 A PTC -> DC-DC boost + inverter at 1.38 MHz -> +12.24 V / -12.13 V -> ferrite + 10 uF -> XH 1 -12V 2 GND 3 +12V

g.text: Up to about 300 mA on +12 V and 150-300 mA on -12 V from a 5 V / 1.5 A source (TI eq. 3, 4 at the 1.95 A limit). Not isolated.

g.desc: Up to about 300 mA on +12 V and 150-300 mA on -12 V from a 5 V / 1.5 A source (TI eq. 3, 4 at the 1.95 A limit). Not isolated.

g.text: After Banana Schplit (pms67, MIT) with TI SLVS493E values: 4.7 uH (not 10 uH), Schottky >= Iout, PSP = PSN = GND (no pulse skipping), INN->VIN ferrite; 5 V TVS and a P-FET soft start (about 0.2 s) after the fuse.

g.desc: After Banana Schplit (pms67, MIT) with TI SLVS493E values: 4.7 uH (not 10 uH), Schottky >= Iout, PSP = PSN = GND (no pulse skipping), INN->VIN ferrite; 5 V TVS and a P-FET soft start (about 0.2 s) after the fuse.
